notes: Resolved by explicit i64-to-i32 address wrapping in the generic code generator.

reproducer.text: Build mncs-atlas/mncs/atlas-model.mncs at language revision a0255f8 with backend mncs-portable-wasm-mvp. The recursive cell flattening path emits LocalGet(i64 scratch) immediately before I32Load, producing an invalid address operand.

requiredBehavior: Recursive flattening must preserve typed cell layout while explicitly normalizing scratch addresses to the address type required by each memory instruction; valid nested-cell programs must produce valid WASM without a consumer-side address workaround.
summary: Atlas nested-cell flattening passed i64 scratch locals directly to WASM i32.load address operands. The generated model artifact was rejected by WASM validation before it could be instantiated.
title: Nested cell loads require explicit WASM address normalization
